title: P9-M 'smuggled' cigarettes seized in Surigao del Sur; 2 arrested

blocks.text: LIANGA, Surigao del Sur — Police seized around P9 million worth of suspected smuggled cigarettes and arrested two individuals during an anti-smuggling operation in Barangay Saint Christine here Friday morning. Operatives from the 1st Surigao del Sur Provincial Mobile Force Company (PMFC), led by acting force commander Maj. Magdalino G. Pimentel Jr., intercepted the contraband at around 8:10 a.m. along with joint police and government intelligence units. The operation was launched after the Surigao del Sur Police Provincial Office Special Operations Group received a tip from a concerned citizen regarding individuals unloading boxes of cigarettes from a roadside vehicle.
